description: This file contains source code for JSON querying and parsing related to RDM (Reflective Data Model) manifest files. It includes functions for searching JSON data, retrieving array lengths, and extracting application details from JSON manifests, specifically tailored for handling app metadata and configurations.

methods.name: INT32 is_index(CHAR const * s)
methods.description: Determines if a string represents an index number and returns its value; returns -1 if not an index.

methods.name: cJSON * cJSON_Search(cJSON const * json,CHAR const * path)
methods.description: Searches within a cJSON object using a path; supports navigation and array indexing.

methods.name: cJSON * cJSON_SearchFile(CHAR const * fname,CHAR const * path)
methods.description: Loads a JSON file, parses it, and searches for a specific path within the JSON structure.

methods.name: INT32 rdmJSONGetLen(CHAR const * pfName,INT32 * pLen)
methods.description: Retrieves the length of an array from a JSON manifest file.

methods.name: INT32 rdmJSONQuery(CHAR const * pfName,CHAR const * pPath,CHAR * pOut)
methods.description: Parses a JSON file and retrieves the data at a specific path, returning the result as a string.

methods.name: INT32 rdmJSONGetAppNames(INT32 idx,CHAR * pAppName)
methods.description: Retrieves application names from a JSON manifest based on index.

methods.name: INT32 rdmJSONGetAppDetID(INT32 idx,RDMAPPDetails * pRdmAppDet)
methods.description: Retrieves detailed app information from JSON by index.

methods.name: INT32 rdmJSONGetAppDetName(CHAR * pName,RDMAPPDetails * pRdmAppDet)
methods.description: Retrieves detailed app information from JSON by application name.

ctags.name: cJSON_Search
ctags.pattern: /^static cJSON* cJSON_Search(cJSON const* json, CHAR const* path)$/

ctags.name: cJSON_SearchFile
ctags.pattern: /^static cJSON* cJSON_SearchFile(CHAR const* fname, CHAR const* path)$/
